title: Johnny Hodges tells Duke about Cootie
summary: Johnny Hodges, once with Chick Webb, recommended Cootie to Duke after Bubber Miley was fired; Cootie had thought the Ellington band comedy music.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Yeah. I want to talk to you -- I saw where you said that before. We'll talk about that when we get to that. Well, okay. So then, when did you meet Johnny Hodges? Through Chick?
Yeah. That's where I met Johnny Hodges.
Why? Because Johnny'd gone with Chick
then.
No, no. No, Johnny was with Duke.
Oh, I guess Johnny was with Chick before you were.
Uh-huh.
Yeah.
Yeah. He was with Chick before me.
Right. So anyway, you met him.
Yeah.
Well, you must have thought that was a beautiful sound, Cootie.
No. Well, I hadn't heard Johnny.
Oh, hadn't you?
No. Because he was up to the Cotton Club.
Yeah.
And the way Chick used to talk about him, you know.
Yeah.
And --
Chick loved him dearly, didn't he?
Yeah. Uh-huh.
Chick used to say they were cousins. Chick used to say they were first cousins.
He used to tell Duke, 'I'm going to get
my two men back from you one day."
(Laughter)
I know he did. And he always thought he would get his two men back.
Yeah. He was a wonderful guy. And after he told Duke about me, after Duke fired Bubber Miley, he said, "Why don't you get Cootie?", Johnny told him. So I never played no music like that.
Yeah. Where had Johnny heard you? He heard you with Fletcher's band, huh?
Heard me with Fletcher's band, maybe, and heard me down at the Bandbox.
You hadn't heard the Ellington band on the --
Yeah. On the radio.
Oh, you had heard it. Oh, on the radio. Yeah.
They used to sound funny. I thought that was comedy music.
Like that jungle music.
Yeah.
Yeah.
Until I left Fletcher, and went up there with Duke.
What did Fletcher have to say when you
No. He said, "Okay, go right ahead."
